Well, let's be honest: The forums aren't even close to as active as they once were. ;-) (Although newer folks wouldn't know that, so no offense intended. :-D )

It really is nice to see you back, Ronway! :-) 

Arenson9, my spouse, and I had a game of SotM today against Baron Blade in Mordengrad. Idealist and Lifeline just didn't get the cards they needed, and Harpy did what she could, but Blade and his forces truly got the jump on us. It was an impressively harsh 6 rounds, but these things happen. :-) 

After Arenson9 left, Idealist and Lifeline came back with Tachyon and Dr. Medico for a rematch. Not only did the heroes get better cards, but they caught Mordengrad off-guard, easily ending the fight in less than 4 rounds with everyone in the high teens at the end. It's amazing how much of a difference 4 heroes, better hero draws, and worse villain/environment draws will make. ;-)  

Anyone else have any games over the holiday weekend? Any other fun activities?

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
Thank you, butI haven't really ever left. I'd be surprised if it ever reads "Last seen: 1 week ago" beneath my name. My phone usually has the tab for the forums open. My posting is less frequent, largely due to how inactive the forums are these days. Boy do I sometimes miss the good old days around here.

 

No SotM games for me, I largely play solo as my usual gaming group isn't as big of a fan as I am. So it has become easier for me just to play on the app for 15 minutes for a game versus an hour with people. 

I did pay Sub-terra and The Resistance the day before Christmas. On Sub-terra, 2 of the 6 people made it out alive. Fortunately I was one of them. 2 of the others were a bit far from everyone else so they weren't able to make it to the found exit in time. Another got blocked by an unlucky horror, with another trying to make it back to save them.

Huh, well, it's sad to hear that these Forums are in somewhat of a "dark age" (even though I wasn't around during "the good ol' days")... I wonder what's causing that... Any ideas?

I did play an interesting game of SotM lately: Progeny versus the Naturalist, Sky-Scraper, KNYFE, and Guise in Freedom Tower. Progeny, on the first turn, played both Scion of Storm cards, followed by an Hour of Reckoning. After that bad start, Progeny started taking us down pretty quickly (with some help from a Time of Tribulations, 1 or more [I forget] Entry Point[s], and the Nemeses Bonus). KNYFE was the first to go, she tried to protect herself with an Overcharged Null-Shield, but it wasn't enough. Next was Guise, who managed to play a semi-impressive chain of "play a card" cards, before he was taken out. Then Sky-Scraper, who did some good stuff her Links before getting Incapacitated. So, only the Naturalist remained, with HP in the low teens. He Transformed into the Nimble Gazelle and used Sky-Scraper's and KNYFE's Incapacitated Abilities to use the Gazelle's healing Power a lot, in addition to Guise's healing Incapacitated Ability. For the rest of the game, the Naturalist switched between the Crocodile, to damage Progeny, and the Gazell, to heal himself. We eventually won, with the Naturalist at 2 HP, and there was a time when he had only 1.
